jobs_results.title: Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We’re looking for a product-oriented Software Engineer that enjoys taking ownership of complex problems with a big scope, working with the end customer as well as the rest of the engineering team to design and implement the best solution. We have a lean working environment with few meetings, focused on having a lot of delivery & interaction with the direct users of the product (mainly our internal account managers as well as the end customers). Engineers at Aldara have a lot of freedom to work on multiple challenges end-to-end, while at the same time forming part of a team with high standards for system architecture, code quality and product usability that fosters great work.

Here are the core traits that define how the tech team works at Aldara.

Lean engineering. Own the problem end-to-end

We don’t have Product Managers, Agile Coaches or Scrum Masters. We trust our engineers to be able to understand the problems at hand, devise the best solution, share it with others and own the... implementation from start to finish. The engineers who excel at Aldara are those that take pleasure in mastering all parts of the stack, from database modeling to UX design, to bring together a fully functional feature. The only big meetings we really have are the biweekly Demos, where engineers come together to share & showcase the latest changes to the rest of the company.

Horizontal structure with few but high quality contributors

You’ll be reporting directly to the CTO, while interacting heavily with Operations and Account Management to get the feedback cycle working. We don’t have teams in engineering, and we want to keep it that way as long as we can by hiring few but very high quality individual contributors. As an engineer, you’ll be deeply integrated with the rest of the team, working often with the internal stakeholders as well as the end customer. You will also be working closely with our providers, from local ones to big corps, as we develop our relationships with them as an additional player in our ecosystem. We believe a horizontal structure with a high motivation for debate brings forward the best product choices.

Focus on building great, scalable software, with rock-solid architecture to deploy it

Our stack is simple: Postgres, Django, React, Terraform, and AWS are the main pieces, with Datadog to keep track of it all. We care a lot about our developer UX and setup to make developers have the easiest time adding a new feature, testing it thoroughly and deploying it in the same beat. We’ve got 95% testing coverage checked on every PR, one-click deployments happening constantly and a carefully thought out code structure that focuses on modular software that can be easily reused. Our local setup replicates the production environment to a tee. Develop locally and instantly debug your traces using Datadog, comparing against production traces.

Freedom to explore and have fun, creativity is our best tool to engineer the future we want

We don’t shy away from investing time in trying out new approaches to problems we need to solve. There’s offsite weeks when we go hack on something for a few days in an amazing venue with full focus. Regular hackathons where the whole team reconfigures into small pods that build something fun for a day or two. We want to foster your curiosity, allow you to explore and find new and better ways to solve problems. We believe the future of our space includes way more automation, AI, and inference than it does now, and we’ll only get there by allowing you to be as creative as possible.

The product you’ll work on

Our current product has three parts: the internal software we use to manage properties, the consumer experience we offer to property owners, and the provider management platform.

Our internal software is the operating system of property management, used by our team of account managers to deliver an 11-star experience to our customers. This includes the streamlining of all aspects of building management: accounting, incident management, customer communications, taxes, utility management, insurance claims, etc.

This is coupled with an intuitive consumer experience, catering to a very diverse set of property owners. From the old grandparents to the star-eyed couple who just bought a flat. Our product has to be inclusive to all walks of life and offer the best service possible. It includes a digital application as well as traditional communication methods (in-person and over the phone).

Our provider platform allows our collaborators to interact with us in an easy and scalable way, and be motivated to work with us as much as possible. It will also give us an easy and structured way to have access to and discoverability of the best providers that can cover each of our customer’s needs.

Preferred Skills and experience
• Working experience across the stack. Ideally you’re someone familiar with our specific stack already (Postgres, Django, React) but this is not a hard requirement. We prioritize people who are good across the board rather than having deep experience with specific libraries.
• Strong ownership culture, you’re someone that enjoys owning big parts of the product and caring for them in all their facets.
• A hands-on attitude and willingness to spend the necessary time researching, analyzing, and identifying the problem to make decisions with as much data as possible to back them up.
• An open-minded approach to software development, with the ability to debate different trade-offs with strong yet highly rational arguments that prioritize what’s best for the project.
• A high level of proactivity and curiosity, we are looking for developers who are excited about problem-solving, thinking creatively comes to them naturally.
• Ability to work from our Barcelona office daily, with the option to work remotely occasionally if the need arises. We’re at the stage of the company where most of the interactions happen in-person, and we plan to keep it that way for the short and medium term.
• Proficiency in Spanish is highly desirable, though not a requirement.

Perks
• 📜 Have a go at changing an antiquated industry - opportunities to combine technology and operations to improve old, massive industries don’t happen every day. Be on the team tackling the challenges head-on, challenging the status quo and inventing ways to solve old problems.
• 📈 Stock Options - we would only imagine you joining us if you have skin in the game. For us, this means owning a piece of the company and sharing in the upside if we succeed.
• ⭐️ Work with a small team of bright people - we are strong believers in small but high impact teams. Expect to work with really talented colleagues with experience in top tech companies and multiple time founders. We keep a high quality bar and pride ourselves for our good work.
• 🤝 Company culture built on trust and transparency - we expect you to speak up and share your feedback openly, in turn we are completely open about our feedback and company direction.
• 🏢 In-person - we believe nothing beats being in the same room and spending time together. From deep working sessions to spending quality time off-work.
• 🤩 Beautiful office - our office is in one of the prime locations in Barcelona (Passeig de Gràcia), with direct view’s to Gaudi’s La Pedrera, and a large terrace where we organize events for our family, friends, and colleagues. Expect beautiful sunsets and easy access to the whole city.
• 👩🎨 Shape the culture - by joining so early in the team, we expect you to have a say in the future of the company, including ways of working, culture and direction. You’ll not only have a front row seat, but actively participate in developing the playbook that gets us to succeed

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero de telecomunicaciones
jobs_results.description:
Já... ¡TE PILLÉ! Si has llegado hasta aquí, lo más probable es que estés buscando un cambio, sumergirte en nuevos proyectos; o...tal vez algo más desafiante.

Desde uno de nuestros clientes, trabajamos para aportar soluciones tecnológicas que den respuesta a las necesidades de nuestros clientes, algo que es posible gracias al talento de nuestro equipo y a nuestra capacidad de adaptarnos a cada situación.

Nuestros clientes son generalmente organismos de la Administración Pública y nuestros proyectos son grandes sistemas de información que contribuyen a facilitar el día a día de nuestro entorno más cercano (educación, sanidad, vivienda, impuestos...).

Seguramente, estás buscando un lugar en el que te sientas como en casa. Así que si has llegado hasta aquí, ¡sigue leyendo!

QUÉ NECESITAMOS PARA HACERLO

- Elaboración e implementación de proyectos de telecomunicaciones.

- Estudios de viabilidad de solución técnica propuesta a cliente.

- Replanteo de instalaciones. Apoyo a la... recopilación de datos sobre instalaciones propias o ajenas, comprobación de estado.

- Integración y/o modificación de servicios red.

- Identificación de necesidades de servicio.

- Definir parámetros y requisitos de integración.

- Análisis, planificación, control, seguimiento e inventariado de todas las actuaciones que se realicen sobre la infraestructura de

fibra óptica o red WiFi.

- Validar y gestión de la infraestructura de los servicios.

- Elaboración de informes de seguimiento.

Y LO MÁS IMPORTANTE... ¿QUÉ TE VAMOS A OFRECER?

24 días laborables de vacaciones todos los años

Conciliación personal, familiar y profesional.

Plan de formación: acceso ilimitado una gran oferta de formaciones on line, también acceso a cursos y certificaciones oficiales. Para que puedas seguir aprendiendo en lo que te gusta o acercarte a nuevas tecnologías y metodologías.

Acompañamiento profesional: contarás con una mentorización desde el momento en el que te incorpores y que junto con el área de Personas construirá contigo tu itinerario de desarrollo personalizado.

Retribución flexible en nómina; con bono transporte, cheque comedor, bono guardería, seguro de salud, etc.

Un amplio catálogo con descuentos para productos y servicios en colaboración con otras empresas (gimnasio, comercios, centros de ocio, salud...)

Participación activa en iniciativas internas y eventos siempre que quieras: teambuilding, dinámicas, actividades outdoor, Navidad, Igualdad....

Si todo esto es lo que siempre has estado buscando, es porque ya eras #talentoproxya. ¡Vamos a conocernos!

¡Conócenos más a través de Instagram!: https://www.instagram.com/somosproxya/?igshid=MzRlODBiNWFlZA%3D%3D

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Are you a Software Engineer seeking a new interesting challenge? 🔍

If your answer is yes, it’s your lucky day so keep reading, it can be just what you're looking for! 👀

✍️ WHAT WILL YOU DO?

We are looking for a dynamic, proactive and talented person to join our team and perform the following tasks:
• Being accountable for delivering quality software quickly, reliably and safely to production, and understanding the customer impact and experience of your contribution.
• Working in agile teams and across the capability areas, contributing to the development and maintenance of products and solutions, community practices at the core of your delivery.
• Applying and adhere to good practice software engineering practices (e.g. DRY principles, TDD and BDD, continuous integration, automated tests, pair programming, code reviews, security) within an agile/iterative development approach.
• Contributing to the continuous development of standards against which software development should take... place as well as exploring and bring in new technologies and tools to boost innovation and development productivity.

💻 WHAT (TECHNOLOGIES/METHODOLOGIES/TOOLS) WILL YOU USE?
• Node, React
• Javascript / Typescript
• GraphQL
• REST APIs
• Mocha / Jest
• Microservices

🧐 WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?
• At least 10 years in a similar role.
• Strong experience as developer in: Node.js, React & web development, JavaScript/TypeScript, GraphQL, REST APIs, testing libraries like Mocha, Jest.
• Strong experience in building microservices using cloud solutions (Docker, Kubernetes, Serverless preferably on GCP).
• Strong experience with GitHub, Terraform and CI/CD pipelines.

📅 WHERE AND WHEN?
• Workplace: Madrid (Once a week from office)
• Work Schedule: Business Hours

🤝 WHAT CAN WE OFFER YOU?
• Permanent contract 📋 - We offer indefinite contracts from the first day.
• Pay and benefits 💸 - Competitive salary and a flexible compensation plan adapted to your needs (Ticket restaurant plan, Childcare Ticket, Transport Ticket and Health Insurance).
• Work from home 🏚️ - We offer you a financial support every month for your working from home expenses. In addition, in the first month we will give you a bonus to help you to set up your workplace 👨💻
• Opportunity knocks 👍🏻 - Being a part of a growing company, we want to support your path with a career development plan and annual performance-based compensation reviews.
• Learn as you grow 📚 - Starting with a fantastic onboarding program, TCS has robust learning platforms that will allow you to learn and grow personal as professionally.
• Bring your buddy 👫 - If you have referred a friend for an open position under the BYB Scheme and she/he is hired you’ll receive a very attractive cash award.
• Connect globally 🌏 - Work with people from all over the world. You can feel the multicultural workforce.
• Benefit from being a TCSer 🎟️ – By being part of the TCS Spain family you can enjoy benefits, offers and corporate discounts on the best brands.
• And so on 🎉 - Appreciations, incentives, Team Building activities, diversity and inclusion programs, sustainability activities, corporative events... This has only just begun!

💡 WHO ARE WE?

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is an Information Technology (IT) company founded in 1968 as part of the Indian Tata Group and is one of the top 3 technology companies globally 🚀

With a presence in 55 countries and more than 615,000 employees, TCS is considered one of the 10 best companies to work for worldwide in 2024 according to the Top Employers Institute 🥇

TCS Spain started operations in 2001 and currently has a diverse workforce that collaborates with the main Spanish and multinational companies 🌏

TCS Spain has been certified as a Top Employer 2024 and has also been chosen as one of the 100 Best Companies to Work for in Spain in 2023 according to Forbes 🏆

Among the portfolio of services, TCS has information technology services, asset-based solutions, global consulting, engineering and industrial services, digital solutions and services, application maintenance and development, quality assurance and testing services, IT infrastructure and BPS 🎯

Responsible for development, TCS Spain is committed to inclusion, diversity and sustainability, and promotes flexibility policies that support wellbeing and work-life balance 💯

WELCOME, WE ARE WAITING FOR YOU! 🚀

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero de software - Javascript
jobs_results.description:
En Inetum, empresa líder en consultoría tecnológica, buscamos incorporar a nuestro equipo un ingeniero de software con experiencia en Javascript dentro de una de las mayores empresas del sector bancario.

REQUISITOS:
• Imprescindible inglés alto, se trabajará en equipos internacionales.
• Experiencia en desarrollo con Javascript.
• Experiencia en desarrollo con Node JS, Java, SQL.
• Experiencia con BBDD Oracle y DB2.
• Docker.

¿QUÉ PODEMOS OFRECERTE?

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
My client is a global leader in cloud software for conversational commerce specialize in empowering businesses to elevate their customer experience.

Their communications and payments platform empowers marketing, sales, and customer support to automate engagement with customers across multiple mobile channels, blended with seamless payment capabilities that drive sales, gain customers and increase customer happiness.

The company is looking for a Java Software Engineer to join their team.

🌏 Working schedule: Hybrid in Madrid, Spain (3 days in the office, 2 days remote)

👉 Candidates MUST be living in Madrid, Spain (NO VISAS provide)

💰 Salary: €65k to €75k gross/year depending on experience.

Your experience
• At least 5+ years of experience with Java
• At least 3+ years of experience with Microservices.
• At least 3+ years of experience with Spring/Sprinboot.
• Solid experience with Docker, Kubernetes.
• Have experience with databases (SQL or NoSQL)
• Very good level of English... (B2-C1 or higher). Internal comunication is in English.
• Card Payment experience or Payment Card Industry or Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) and Europay MasterCard Visa (EMV).

Ideally looking for:
• Experience with Kotlin (Not mandatory)
• Ideally experience with Cloud - AWS (Not mandatory)
• Ideally experience with Kafka or RabbitMQ (Not mandatory)

Benefits
• Competitive salary with flexible compensation plan and relocation packages for EU citizens.
• 27 days paid holiday
• Work time flexibility

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer - Data Infrastructure
jobs_results.description:
Canonical is building a comprehensive automation suite to provide multi-cloud and on-premise data solutions for the enterprise. The data platform team is a collaborative team that develops a full range of data stores and data technologies, spanning from big data, through NoSQL, cache-layer capabilities, and analytics; all the way to structured SQL engines.

We are facing the interesting problem of fault-tolerant mission-critical distributed systems and intend to deliver the world's best automation solution for delivering data platforms.

We have a number of openings ranging anywhere from junior to senior level. We will help you identify a suitable position depending on your experience and interests. Engineers who thrive at Canonical are mindful of open-source community dynamics and equally aware of the needs of large, innovative organisations.

Location: This is a Globally remote role

What your day will look like

The data platform team is responsible for the automation of data... platform operations. This includes ensuring fault-tolerant replication, TLS, installation, and much more; but also provides domain-specific expertise on the actual data system to other teams within Canonical. This role is focused on the creation and automation of features of data platforms, not analysing the data in them.
• Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
• Write high-quality, idiomatic Python code to create new features
• Debug issues and interact with upstream communities publicly
• Work with helpful and talented engineers including experts in many fields
• Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
• Work from home with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you
• Proven hands-on experience in software development using Python
• Proven hands-on experience in distributed systems
• Have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM, or a similar degree
• Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

You might also bring a subset of experience from the following, which will determine the exact role and level we consider you for:
• Experience operating and managing data platform technologies like PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, OpenSearch, Kafka, Yugabyte, Trino, Superset, Atlas, Ranger, and Redis
• Experience with Linux systems administration, package management, and operations
• Experience with the public cloud or a private cloud solution like OpenStack
• Experience with operating Kubernetes clusters and a belief that it can be used for serious persistent data services

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.
• Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
• Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
• Annual compensation review
• Recognition rewards
• Annual holiday leave
• Parental Leave
• Employee Assistance Programme
• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
• Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal-opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration

jobs_results.title: Frontend Software Engineer, React-TypeScript
jobs_results.description:
Frontend Software Engineer, React-TypeScript

At DataBeacon our mission is to revolutionize the aviation industry using a modern technology stack, open source technologies and lean architectures.

Our first product is SimpliFID, an Aerodrome Flight Information Service (AFIS) that covers most functionalities of a radar system at a fraction of the costs. Built in Rust, Python and TypeScript, it sources data from ADB-S and Mode-S Secondary Surveillance Radar (SSR) systems over Asterix CAT021 Surveillance Data Exchange protocol and delivers it to the user with near zero-latency. Our main focus is on scalability, security and the development and discovery of additional products in the real-time data services for aviation space.

In anticipation to the exciting challenges ahead, we look forward to extend our engineering team with an exceptional TypeScript and React Software Engineer.

What would you do:
• develop, maintain and improve DataBeacon’s frontend applications,
• work with a small... and highly motivated, skilled team of engineers,
• participate in the company technical decisions and roadmap,
• space to experiment and try-out new exciting technologies,
• have minimal administrative overhead and the possibility to create a real impact,
• submit your first patch in less than a week and the first feature in a month,

You must have:
• at least 3+ of relevant professional experience building reliable software applications,
• mastery of TypeScript, React and a client state management library, eg. Redux,
• have a good command of English and good communication skills,
• be located in Madrid or surroundings.

Nice to have:
• professional experience using MapBox or MapLibre,
• experience using Web Sockets and/or Server Side Events,
• motivation for learning Rust and Web Assembly,
• familiarity with containerized distributed applications deployed in AWS,
• experience building critical software applications in highly regulated sectors,
• affinity for aviation in general.

What we offer:
• a total of 25 vacation days, including Christmas' and New Year’s eves,
• hybrid and work-from-home policies tailored to your needs,
• a beautiful office in the center of Madrid, near Alonso Martinez,
• yearly budget for continuous learning, conferences, books, courses,
• a fairly generous compensation, reviewed yearly, and a personal growth plan.

If this position and our mission resonates with you, we would be excited to hear from you

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
ABOUT US:

TrustCloud is a global tech company with a state-of-the-art choreographer that orchestrates and vaults secure digital transactions. Our TrustCloud Platform helps corporations to secure online transactions worldwide.

Due to our company's growth, we are seeking highly productive, dynamic, hardworking, and effective Software Engineers who are capable of working in a team and committed to results and responsibilities.

RESPONSABILITIES:
• Systems design, programming, and software development using C#, .NET Core, and other relevant technologies.
• Designing and administering databases, including tasks such as implementation, modification, and optimization.
• Collaborating with Agile Methodologies, specifically SCRUM, to ensure efficient project management and delivery.

REQUIREMENTS:
• Relevant experience in systems design, programming, and software support.
• A minimum of 6 years of experience as a developer, with expertise in C#, .NET, etc.
• Familiarity with Agile... Methodologies, particularly SCRUM.
• Effective communication and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently and make decisions within established guidelines.

DESIRABLE:
• Knowledge in WPF, Entity Framework, Bootstrap, Angular, Postman, etc.
• Proficiency in Transact-SQL, including stored procedures, views, cursors, etc.
• Familiarity with Microsoft Online tools such as Visual Studio, SharePoint, and Office 365.
• Construction and management of APIs.
• Experience with Team Foundation Server.
• Familiarity with Test Framework.
• Application and platform migration experience.

WHAT WE OFFER:
• Exciting and challenging projects with a strong focus on research and development.
• Opportunities for career development and growth.
• A pleasant and collaborative working environment, where you can thrive as part of a dedicated team.
• Competitive compensation package based on your professional background.
• Flexible work schedule to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
• Possibility of a hybrid work model, combining office and remote work
